explanation: Olive oil is pressed from the whole fruit rather than from a seed, so it can be eaten fresh without refining. Extra virgin oil is extracted without heat or chemical solvents.

claims.text: Olive oil is pressed from olives, the oil at the centre of Mediterranean cooking.
Lemons, figs and dates are not pressed for the cooking oil of the Mediterranean.
Olive oil is extracted from the whole fruit's flesh, unlike oils pressed from seeds, and good oil can be eaten without refining.
Extra virgin olive oil is extracted mechanically, without heat or chemical solvents.
